name: auth-gate
description: HX-01 fixture: login validation branch of the authorized lab auth gate

inputs.totp: string, optional, 6 digits when 2fa is pending

experiments: EXP-1: submit valid credentials once -> expect pending_2fa

EXP-3: submit valid totp while pending_2fa -> expect authenticated
